claims.claim: Reviewers describe the gameplay as repetitive over time, involving routine tasks and work cycles.

citations.review_text:
You farm, you sell, you repeat.
The game is so impressively repetitive. I had a glimmer of hope. Hope that the game would at some point offer something new.
Some feeling of progress. But no.
It was such a drag to play

This game offers a surprisingly deep and detailed look into the world of farming. The amount of effort put into recreating real farming equipment, crops, techniques, and production chains is impressive. As someone who knew very little about agriculture beforehand, I found myself learning quite a bit simply by playing.

The attention to detail is both the game's greatest strength and its biggest weakness. While it succeeds in creating an authentic farming experience, that authenticity also means spending a lot of time performing routine tasks. After the initial novelty wears off, the gameplay can become repetitive, with many activities feeling like variations of the same work cycle.

Overall, it's an impressive simulation that excels at teaching players about modern farming and providing a realistic experience. Whether you enjoy it long-term will largely depend on how much satisfaction you get from the slow, methodical nature of agricultural work.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players embrace the grinding gameplay loops, yet report loading screens in the modhub and artificial intelligence errors with hired workers.

claims.claim: Reviewers report encountering an artificial intelligence bug where hired workers randomly stop working or ignore specific areas of land during harvesting and seeding tasks.

citations.review_text:
Even (as of 2026) 7 years later, this game in my opinion has aged perfectly, I think all of the games in the series have and been good releases. Its a game that can preforms greatly before I was given a 5070 for a Christmas Gift. Here are some Highs and Lows of this game

PROS:
- Addition of John Deere brings a handful of machinery to drive and strive for
- Lots of Mods to chose from
- Newer AI system
- Fresh Radio

CONS:
- A weird bug in the AI system i ran into a bug where the AI just randomly stopped, the combine was not full and when I hired a AI to Seed the land it ignored the same area as the harvester
- No more constantly updating mods
- Radio can get annoying with smaller songs per catalog.

FS19 is a great medium level farming game compared to the latest available. Tons to do with plenty of automations possible. Be careful not to tax the Giants 8 programming by running too many simultaneous AI workers (3 harvesters max with 3 auger wagons). The more AutoDrive command clicks the quicker the game will freeze. Just be aware. Take your time and you'll enjoy the game. Tons of mods (some less polished than others).

Plus, there's a bug with the modhub screen where it takes a very long time to load/re-load (one time, it took 5 minutes to exit a mod page).
